description: Spend in USD for the last N days: the total, by platform, charged / free / failed call counts and the current discount, plus recent wallet entries (top-ups, charges, refunds, bonuses). Needs the account read permission "billing:read" on this key: keys not limited to product lines have the three read permissions by default; for a key limited to product lines, the account owner turns it on in the console (API Keys → permissions). Free.
name: everyinfra_billing
title: Spend and ledger
